plainTextExcerpts: For Earth-observation satellite imagery, does computing the angular power spectrum on an equal-area HEALPix grid, compared with a regular geographic lon/lat grid, remove the latitude-dependent area bias in the spectral amplitude?
Angular power spectrum analysis performed on an equal-area HEALPix tessellation of the sphere defined on the WGS84 ellipsoid.
The same analysis on a regular geographic latitude/longitude grid, whose cells shrink in surface area towards the poles.
Presence or absence of a latitude-dependent bias in the spectral amplitude / power as a function of spatial scale.
